Initial release: Infrastructure as Code security auditor for Terraform, CloudFormation, and Pulumi.

- Detects 12 high-impact cloud misconfigurations (public S3, open security groups, hardcoded credentials, unencrypted EBS/RDS/S3, wildcard IAM policies, public RDS, and more)
- Supports .tf, YAML/JSON CloudFormation, and Pulumi (TypeScript/Python) files
- Pure static analysis with zero external dependencies, no tfsec/checkov required
- CI fail-gate and severity filtering options included
- Simple CLI usage for directories or single files
- Does not require AWS/cloud credentials
